stipend.en: Pay is not stated on the posting; Al-Meydan is Qatar Foundation's student internship scheme. Confirm with almeydan@qf.org.qa.

deadline_note: Closing date shown on the Qatar Foundation internships portal is 19 Nov 2026. The portal lists new calls as they open.

duration.en: Not stated on the posting (confirm with Al-Meydan)
duration.ar: غير محددة في الإعلان (يُرجى التأكد من برنامج الميدان)

summary.en: Lab-based research assistant internship at HBKU's Qatar Biomedical Research Institute (DRC group), placed through Qatar Foundation's Al-Meydan programme for Education City students.
summary.ka: ლაბორატორიული კვლევითი ასისტენტის სტაჟირება HBKU-ს ყატარის ბიოსამედიცინო კვლევითი ინსტიტუტში (DRC), Qatar Foundation-ის Al-Meydan პროგრამით.
summary.ar: تدريب مساعد باحث في المختبر بمعهد قطر لبحوث الطب الحيوي (جامعة حمد بن خليفة) - مجموعة DRC، عبر برنامج الميدان التابع لمؤسسة قطر.

about.en:
A current call on the Qatar Foundation internships portal for a research assistant intern at QBRI (DRC). The intern supports ongoing laboratory research: preparing culture media, buffers and reagents, assisting with protein purification and sample preparation, supporting routine molecular biology assays, keeping accurate records, and following biosafety rules and good laboratory practice.

The posting does not state the duration, hours or pay; those are confirmed by the Al-Meydan team (almeydan@qf.org.qa, +974 4454 0352, Multaqa Student Center, Education City).

en: Hands-on wet-lab experience at a national biomedical research institute
Open call with a 19 Nov 2026 closing date
Apply through the Qatar Foundation student internships portal
ka: პრაქტიკული ლაბორატორიული გამოცდილება ეროვნულ ბიოსამედიცინო ინსტიტუტში
ღია კონკურსი, ბოლო ვადა 2026 წლის 19 ნოემბერი

التقديم عبر بوابة التدريب الطلابي في مؤسسة قطر

eligibility.en: Open to students enrolled at a Qatar Foundation university with a GPA of 2.5 or higher. Nationality is not restricted on the posting. Students on scholarships must check that their scholarship permits work. Basic knowledge of molecular biology and biochemistry is expected.

how_to_apply: Open the posting on the Qatar Foundation internships portal
Log in or register as a student on the portal
Submit the application before 19 Nov 2026
Questions: almeydan@qf.org.qa or mehnaty@qf.org.qa

costs.en: No application fee. Pay and hours are not stated on the posting.

score_reason: Specific open call with a near deadline; limited to QF university students; pay not stated.

org: Qatar Environment and Energy Research Institute (HBKU)

name.ar: برنامج البحث الصيفي في معهد قطر لبحوث البيئة والطاقة (جامعة حمد بن خليفة)

stipend.en: Stipend not mentioned on the programme page.

deadline_note: Annual summer programme. The latest published call (2024) ran 19 May-18 Jul 2024 with a 12 May 2024 deadline; the next call is normally posted in spring. Check the QEERI page.

summary.en: Eight-week summer research placement at QEERI, HBKU's energy, water and environment institute, for STEM undergraduates living in Qatar.
summary.ka: რვაკვირიანი საზაფხულო კვლევითი სტაჟირება QEERI-ში, HBKU-ს ენერგიის, წყლისა და გარემოს ინსტიტუტში, ყატარში მცხოვრები STEM სტუდენტებისთვის.
summary.ar: تدريب بحثي صيفي لمدة ثمانية أسابيع في معهد قطر لبحوث البيئة والطاقة بجامعة حمد بن خليفة لطلبة العلوم والتقنية المقيمين في قطر.

about.en:
QEERI places STEM undergraduates in its research centres (energy, water, corrosion, environment and sustainability) for eight weeks over the summer, working on a project with a scientist mentor. The 2024 call ran Sunday to Thursday, 8:30-15:30, and asked for two project choices.

The call is annual but the dates change each year; the 2024 page is the latest published one, so watch the QEERI page for the next call (usually spring).

en: Eight weeks inside a national energy and environment research institute
No specific nationality required, but a Qatar residence permit is
ka: რვა კვირა ენერგიისა და გარემოს ეროვნულ კვლევით ინსტიტუტში
ეროვნება არ არის მითითებული, მაგრამ საჭიროა ყატარის ბინადრობის ნებართვა
ar: ثمانية أسابيع داخل معهد وطني لبحوث الطاقة والبيئة
لا تُشترط جنسية محددة لكن يلزم تصريح إقامة قطري

eligibility.en: Per the latest (2024) call: valid Qatar residence permit and Qatar ID; enrolled in an undergraduate STEM programme with at least two years of coursework completed; cumulative GPA of at least 3.0/4.0. No nationality restriction is stated. Check that the same rules apply to the next call.

how_to_apply: Watch the QEERI Summer Research Program page for the next call
Prepare the application form, CV, letter of interest, two faculty recommendation letters, transcript and Qatar ID copy
Choose two preferred projects
Submit the online form before the deadline

costs.en: No fee. Stipend is not stated on the page.

score_reason: Annual HBKU research institute internship open to residents of any nationality; latest published cycle is 2024.

type: student sponsorship with annual internship (Qatari nationals)

name.en: Vodafone Qatar Sponsorship Programme (with annual internship)
name.ar: برنامج الرعاية في فودافون قطر (مع تدريب سنوي)

stipend.en: Financial support throughout university plus a 4-week placement each year; amounts not published.

deadline_note: Rolling; no deadline stated on the page. Apply through the Vodafone Qatar jobs portal.

duration.ar: طوال الدراسة الجامعية؛ تدريب أربعة أسابيع كل سنة

summary.en: Telecom company sponsors Qatari university students and places them in a 4-week internship every year, with a route into its graduate programme.
summary.ka: სატელეკომუნიკაციო კომპანია აფინანსებს ყატარელ სტუდენტებს და ყოველწლიურად 4-კვირიან სტაჟირებას სთავაზობს, კურსდამთავრებულთა პროგრამაზე გადასვლის შესაძლებლობით.
summary.ar: شركة اتصالات تكفل الطلبة القطريين في الجامعة وتوفر لهم تدريباً لمدة أربعة أسابيع كل سنة مع مسار إلى برنامج الخريجين.

about.en:
Vodafone Qatar's sponsorship programme supports Qatari students at university with financial support and a 4-week internship placement once a year. After graduation sponsored students are employed in their specialist area and can apply to the Discover Graduate programme.

It is a nationals-only programme.

en: 4-week placement every year of the sponsorship
Path to the Discover Graduate programme

eligibility.en: Qatari nationals only. High school completed with 75% or above; university GPA of at least 2.1; proficient English.

how_to_apply: Read the sponsorship page on vodafone.qa
Click Apply Now to open the Vodafone Qatar jobs portal
Create a profile and submit the application
Shortlisted candidates are contacted by Vodafone Qatar

costs.en: No application fee; sponsorship costs are covered by Vodafone Qatar.

score_reason: Nationals-only; internship is part of a sponsorship scheme; pay amounts not published.

name.ar: برنامج التدريب الصيفي في PwC قطر (الصفقات والضرائب والقانون وغيرها)

stipend.en: Pay is not stated on the posting.

deadline_note: Annual summer programme. The 2026 Deals posting (6 Jun 2026) is filled; PwC Middle East usually posts the next summer intake in the spring. Watch careers.pwc.com.

summary.en: Summer internship in PwC's Doha office (Deals and other service lines) for Qatari students entering their final year.
summary.ka: საზაფხულო სტაჟირება PwC-ის დოჰას ოფისში (Deals და სხვა მიმართულებები) ყატარელი სტუდენტებისთვის, რომლებიც ბოლო კურსზე გადადიან.
summary.ar: تدريب صيفي في مكتب PwC بالدوحة (الصفقات وخطوط خدمة أخرى) للطلبة القطريين المقبلين على سنتهم الأخيرة.

about.en:
PwC Middle East runs summer internships in Doha aimed at students entering their final year, lasting about six to eight weeks between June and August. The posting for the 2026 Deals Summer Internship Programme was titled 'Qatari Nationals Only' and was marked filled on the page. PwC also lists Tax and Legal summer programmes for 2026 in Qatar.

The summer programme repeats each year, so use it as a pattern to plan for; open calls appear on the PwC Middle East careers site.

en: Big Four summer internship in Doha
ar: تدريب صيفي في إحدى الشركات الأربع الكبرى بالدوحة

eligibility.en: Qatari nationals only. Students entering their final year of study (per the 2026 programme description).

how_to_apply: Check the PwC Middle East careers site for the next Qatar summer internship posting
Register for the talent community to be alerted
Apply online with CV and transcript
Complete the assessments and interviews if shortlisted
score_reason: Prestigious but nationals-only, 2026 posting filled, next cycle date unconfirmed.

deadline_note: Rolling: summer and year-round placements; no deadline listed. Register interest by email.

summary.en: QFC places talented students from Qatar's leading universities into teams in policy, marketing, strategy and digital innovation.
summary.ka: QFC ყატარის წამყვანი უნივერსიტეტების ნიჭიერ სტუდენტებს აყენებს პოლიტიკის, მარკეტინგის, სტრატეგიისა და ციფრული ინოვაციის გუნდებში.
summary.ar: يوزّع مركز قطر للمال الطلبة الموهوبين من أبرز جامعات قطر على فرق السياسات والتسويق والاستراتيجية والابتكار الرقمي.

about.en:
The QFC internship programme, branded Rising Stars, offers summer and year-round placements to students from Qatar's leading universities. Interns are matched to teams that suit their academic background and interests, working in areas such as policy, marketing, strategy and digital innovation.

The page gives no nationality rule, pay or dates; contact internships@qfc.qa for these.

en: Placement at Qatar's international financial centre
Matched to a team by background and interest
ka: გუნდში განაწილება განათლებისა და ინტერესების მიხედვით

التوزيع على الفرق حسب الخلفية والاهتمام

eligibility.en: Students from Qatar's leading universities. No nationality rule is stated on the page; confirm with internships@qfc.qa.

how_to_apply: Open the Life at QFC page
Use the Register Your Interest link (emails internships@qfc.qa)
Send your CV, university and preferred area
QFC contacts shortlisted students
score_reason: Official programme, rolling; few details published.

name.en: CMU-Q Qatar Student Initiated Undergraduate Research Program (QSIURP)
name.ka: CMU-Q-ის სტუდენტების ინიცირებული საზაფხულო კვლევითი პროგრამა (QSIURP)
name.ar: برنامج البحث الجامعي بمبادرة الطلبة في جامعة كارنيجي ميلون في قطر (QSIURP)

stipend.en: Funded summer research fellowship; amount not published on the page.

deadline_note: Annual; no dates on the page. Ask the CMU-Q research office for the proposal deadline.

summary.en: CMU-Q funds undergraduates in any field to run their own summer research projects under a faculty advisor; projects often become senior honors theses.
summary.ka: CMU-Q აფინანსებს ბაკალავრებს ნებისმიერი დარგიდან, რომ საკუთარი საზაფხულო კვლევა ჩაატარონ ფაკულტეტის მრჩევლის ხელმძღვანელობით.
summary.ar: تموّل جامعة كارنيجي ميلون في قطر طلبة البكالوريوس من أي تخصص لإجراء مشاريع بحثية صيفية بمبادرتهم تحت إشراف عضو هيئة تدريس.

about.en:
QSIURP gives qualified CMU-Q undergraduates funding to carry out summer research driven by their own interests, in any field. Students submit a proposal and work with a faculty advisor. A sister programme, SURA (Summer Undergraduate Research Apprenticeship), gives credit for working on a faculty project without prior research experience.

The page lists neither dates nor amounts.

en: Often leads to a senior honors thesis
ka: დაფინანსებული, სტუდენტის მიერ შემუშავებული საზაფხულო კვლევა

eligibility.en: Open to qualified undergraduates enrolled at CMU-Q in any field; no nationality rule on the page. Not open to students from other universities.

how_to_apply: Open the CMU-Q Student Research and Innovation page
Develop a project idea and find a CMU-Q faculty advisor
Submit the proposal to the CMU-Q research office
Ask the office about the current deadline and award size

costs.en: No fee; funded by CMU-Q. Award size is not published.

score_reason: Limited to CMU-Q students; no dates or amounts published.
